### 3. My Experience Learning Omarchy & Arch Linux: A Productive Developer Setup

### 4. Why I Use This Command: Supercharge Your Daily Standups with a Single Git Alias

- Category: Git & Productivity

- Summary: Explains the exact Git command (`git log --all --no-merges --since="yesterday" --author="Shekhar" --pretty=format:"* %s"`) and alias setup (`git huddle`) to effortlessly generate daily standup bullet summaries in seconds.
